title: UEFA CEDB  - 12.05.2026
text:
CONTROL, ETHICS AND DISCIPLINARY BODY  

Decisions of 12 May 2026

 
 
 
 
 CEDB – 12 May 2026 

Dear Sir or Madam, 

Please see below the main elements of the decisions taken by the UEFA Control, Ethics and Disciplinary 
Body (CEDB) on 12 May 2026. 

If, following a request by the party concerned, a decision with grounds is issued, that full decision will be 
made available in the case law section of this website after it becomes final and binding. 

To navigate this document, you can click on the name of a case in the contents to jump to that particular 
sanction and click on the header at the top of any page to return to the contents.  

We trust this document will be of interest.  

Yours faithfully, 

UEFA 

Angelo Rigopoulos  
Executive Director of Integrity & Regulatory  

William McAuliffe 
Head of Disciplinary

UEFA Conference League 2025/2026 

AEK Larnaca FC vs. Crystal Palace F.C. (1:2); 19 March 2026 

AEK Larnaca FC 

Incident and sanction: 

•  Racist and/or discriminatory behaviour, Art. 14 DR 

  Fine: €50,000 
  Partial stadium closure for the next one (1) UEFA club competition match it plays as host club.

 CEDB – 12 May 2026 

European Under-19 Championship 2027 

Latvia vs. Belarus; 15 May 2026 

Incident and sanction: 

•  Refusal to play, Art. 28.01 Regulations of the UEFA European Under-19 Championship in conjunction with 

Art. 27 UEFA DR 

  To declare the match as forfeited by the Latvian Football Federation (who is therefore deemed to 

have lost the match 3-0) for being responsible for the match not taking place.
